description: Defines the SparseTensorImpl class in the ATen library, implementing sparse tensor operations in COO format, including metadata management, resizing, and copying functionalities.

classes.name: SparseTensorImpl
classes.description: Implementation of sparse tensor in COO format, managing indices, values, and metadata, with methods for resizing, copying, and managing coalesced state.

methods.name: refresh_numel
methods.description: Recomputes the number of elements, with overflow check.

methods.name: nnz
methods.description: Returns the number of non-zero elements.

methods.name: sym_nnz
methods.description: Returns the symbolic size of non-zero elements.

methods.name: sparse_dim
methods.description: Returns the number of sparse dimensions.

methods.name: dense_dim
methods.description: Returns the number of dense dimensions.

methods.name: coalesced
methods.description: Checks if the tensor is coalesced.

methods.name: indices
methods.description: Returns the indices tensor.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns the values tensor.

methods.name: set_size
methods.description: Sets the size of a dimension.

methods.name: set_stride
methods.description: Sets the stride of a dimension.

methods.name: set_storage_offset
methods.description: Sets the storage offset.

methods.name: has_storage
methods.description: Checks if tensor has storage (debug mode).

methods.name: raw_resize_
methods.description: Resizes tensor without preserving invariants, updates sparse and dense dims.

methods.name: _resize_
methods.description: Resizes tensor, preserving invariants, with templated size input.

methods.name: resize_
methods.description: Overloaded resize method with specific size types.

methods.name: resize_and_clear_
methods.description: Resizes tensor and clears indices and values.

methods.name: set_coalesced
methods.description: Sets the coalesced state.

methods.name: set_nnz_and_narrow
methods.description: Narrows nnz and updates indices and values.

methods.name: set_indices_and_values_unsafe
methods.description: Sets indices and values directly without checks.

methods.name: shallow_copy_and_detach_core
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy and detaches, considering dispatch modes.

methods.name: shallow_copy_and_detach
methods.description: Public interface for shallow copy and detach, with versioning.

methods.name: shallow_copy_from
methods.description: Copies metadata from another TensorImpl.
